{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert customer_segment to lowercase for consistency
data['customer_segment'] = data['customer_segment'].str.lower()

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
revenue_numeric = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for NaN values after conversion
print(f'Number of non-numeric entries in revenue: {revenue_numeric.isna().sum()}')

# Check the unique values in the original revenue column
temp_unique = data['revenue'].unique()
print(f'Unique values in revenue before conversion: {temp_unique}')

# Check the unique values in the converted revenue column
print(f'Unique values in revenue after conversion: {revenue_numeric.unique()}')"}
